name: Urea prilling tower
description: Tall tower in which molten urea is sprayed from the top and solidifies in falling droplets cooled by rising air, producing small round prills. Tower height and airflow set the prill size and the product's cooling and hardening; prills are smaller and more spherical than fluid-bed granules.
applications: urea finishing to solid prilled product

specifications.basis: height varies with plant load and weather

source.note: Baboo, Prilling tower and granulator heat and mass transfer, 2021, read 2026-11-17

specifications.basis: large prilling units of at least 3,000 t/d of urea prills
